name: project_editor_output_read
description: Read the project’s effective export canvas, soundtrack, and unchecked-coverage policy.

name: project_editor_output_set
description: Change one or more persistent export settings in a single undoable edit. Save the open project to persist the edit to disk.

operation_id.description: Unique operation identifier. Repeat the exact request after a lost reply.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Use an even value.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Use an even value.

frame_rate.description: Frames per second, for example 25 or 30000/1001.

audio_mode.description: Soundtrack mode. Still timelines use the still soundtrack tools.

audio_ids.description: One feed ID for iso, one camera ID for follow, or mix lane IDs for lanes. Omit for program or silence.

unresolved_privacy.description: Stop export on unchecked coverage or cover the unchecked picture.

name: project_file_output_read
description: Read the project’s effective export canvas, soundtrack, and unchecked-coverage policy. Poll file_job_status_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for a distinct file job. Reuse it to retry an identical request.

name: project_file_output_set
description: Change one or more persistent export settings in a single undoable edit. Supply either out_project or in_place. Poll file_job_status_read with the returned job_id.

operation_id.description: Fresh UUID for a distinct file job. Reuse it to retry an identical request.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Use an even value.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Use an even value.

frame_rate.description: Frames per second, for example 25 or 30000/1001.

audio_mode.description: Soundtrack mode. Still timelines use the still soundtrack tools.

audio_ids.description: One feed ID for iso, one camera ID for follow, or mix lane IDs for lanes. Omit for program or silence.

unresolved_privacy.description: Stop export on unchecked coverage or cover the unchecked picture.

out_project.description: Absolute path for a new .cut document. Choose one destination.

in_place.description: Set true to update the original saved project.
